decisions.reason: As a recent extension close to the firm's existing fluid-handling and fabricated metal capabilities, it is likely to be retained because management has already committed resources and has no clear evidence yet that weak demand is permanent.

Although public waste bins are relatively distant from the firm's traditional offer, the launch of several models and the public listing on the website make management prone to continue rather than quickly reverse course.
This product line fits the firm's metalworking base and broadening strategy well, and the visible commitment across several models increases the tendency to keep it on the market.

Cast iron ground sleeves are related to the firm's core fabrication business, and with the product only just launched management is likely to attribute any early weakness to a temporary market start-up phase.
Steel ground sleeves are strongly aligned with the firm's existing materials expertise and customer base, so sunk effort and strategic fit make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
